# GreenGrid India

> High-voltage clean power infrastructure platform connecting Indian AI data center campuses to round-the-clock solar, wind, BESS, and pumped-hydro generation.

GreenGrid tracks and models 400kV/765kV substation interconnects, CERC Green Energy Open Access frameworks, and round-the-clock power purchase agreements for hyperscale facilities across Mumbai, Noida, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, and Visakhapatnam.

## Core Infrastructure & Documentation
- [National GIS Radar](https://greengrid.in/map): Interactive geospatial telemetry mapping 400kV/765kV substations, utility IPP generation parks, and hyperscale AI campuses.
- [Dispatch Sizing Engine](https://greengrid.in/#sizing): 8,760-hour hourly load-following simulation for solar, wind, battery storage (BESS), and pumped hydro.
- [Indian AI Data Centers](https://greengrid.in/#indian-dcs): Verified technical registry of operational and planned hyperscale compute facilities (Yotta, AdaniConneX, Digital Edge, Sify, Equinix).
- [Renewable Energy Suppliers](https://greengrid.in/#suppliers): Utility-scale IPP and C&I renewable developers across India (Adani Green, ReNew, Tata Power, Avaada, JSW, Greenko, CleanMax).
- [Procurement Frameworks](https://greengrid.in/#frameworks): CERC Green Energy Open Access, group captive SPVs, and RTC/FDRE contracting structures.
- [Offtake Advisory Desk](https://greengrid.in/#inquiry): Siting pre-feasibility and 400kV substation bay reservation inquiries.
